site_or_subject: Cerrillos Data Center (Google / Inversiones y Servicios Dataluna Ltda.)
record: RCA Res. Ex. N° 127 (24 Feb 2020) approved a design drawing up to 169 L/s of groundwater from purchased rights in the Acuífero Santiago Central, a sector under restriction since 2005 and a prohibition zone since 1 Feb 2020. On 26 Feb 2024 the Segundo Tribunal Ambiental (R-271-2020 acum. R-270-2020) partially annulled the RCA and Res. Ex. 524/2020 for lack of evidence of no significant impact on the aquifer, ordered the SEA to roll back the evaluation to incorporate climate-change effects, and suspended the project until a complementary RCA is issued. In Sept 2024 Dataluna told the SEA it would not proceed with the approved project and would start a new air-cooled design from scratch.

site_or_subject: Data Center Pecém (Casa dos Ventos; ByteDance reported client)
record: ONS connection approval reported 30 May 2025 after an earlier rejection on grid-stability grounds; 300 MW initial, up to 900 MW; operations slated Jan 2027. Semace licensed phase 1 via a 658-page Relatório Ambiental Simplificado (31 impacts, 10 significant) classed low-impact; phase 1 210 MW average draw (5,040 MWh/day); water 18–30 m³/day via closed-loop air-cooled chillers, two SRH water-use permits, and an 18 Aug 2025 Cipp S/A–Utilitas reuse-water agreement replacing initially planned artesian wells. On 22 Oct 2025 Idec, the Anacé people, Terramar and Frei Tito asked the MPF to suspend licensing and annul the licença prévia, citing lack of EIA/Rima and ILO 169 consultation. On 10 Sep 2026 the MPF and DPU filed Ação Civil Pública nº 0080626-66.2026.4.05.8100 against builder Omnia and Semace (State of Ceará and Caucaia later added), stating that the licença prévia and licença de instalação had been granted on an RAS, citing 300 MW installed power, ~70 ha and 120 diesel generators, and seeking to bar the operating licence and energisation pending ILO 169 consultation of the Anacé, an EIA/Rima and groundwater pumping tests.
